اضطرعت (form VIII)
# اِضْطَرَعْتُ (iḍṭaraʕtu) /idˤ.tˤa.raʕ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِضْطَرَعَ (iḍṭaraʕa)
# اِضْطَرَعْتَ (iḍṭaraʕta) /idˤ.tˤa.raʕ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِضْطَرَعَ (iḍṭaraʕa)
# اِضْطَرَعْتِ (iḍṭaraʕti) /idˤ.tˤa.raʕ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِضْطَرَعَ (iḍṭaraʕa)
# اِضْطَرَعَتْ (iḍṭaraʕat) /idˤ.tˤa.ra.ʕat/: thi
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
